programme.title: The Nutty Professor

programme.title: Midsommar

programme.title: Vacancy

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw

programme.title: Sumotherhood

programme.title: Black Dynamite

programme.title: Barbershop

programme.title: The Bouncer

programme.title: Seven Swords (2005)

programme.title: Chasing Amy
programme.desc: Cult comic-book artist Holden falls head-over-heels with fellow artist Alyssa, but, for that love to live, he'll need to contend with his disapproving best friend Banky, her sexuality, and his own misgivings about himself in this Kevin Smith classic.

programme.title: Bottle Rocket

programme.title: Catch and Release

programme.title: Steel Magnolias

programme.title: About Last Night (1986)

programme.title: The Usual Suspects

programme.title: Disturbia

programme.title: Shutter Island

programme.title: Shutter Island

programme.title: Sixgun

programme.title: Drugstore June

programme.title: A Fish Called Wanda

programme.title: Ghost

programme.title: Copycat

programme.title: Defiance

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates

programme.desc: A woman asks her ex-lover for help in order to save her outlaw husband from a gang out to kill him.

programme.title: The Three Musketeers (2011)

programme.title: Beowulf

programme.title: The Crow

programme.title: State Property

programme.title: Scream

programme.title: Raging Bull
